## CSD3

### HPC and AI Clinic

**What it is:** Support clinic for users working with Research Computing Services systems.

**Why it matters:** Useful for technical questions around compute, HPC workflows and AI-related infrastructure.

**Best fit:** Technical support / local infrastructure

**Notes:** Focused on practical technical challenges.

## Accelerate Programme for Scientific Discovery

### Accelerate Science Resource Hub: Training

**Link:** <https://docs.science.ai.cam.ac.uk/training/>

**What it is:** A curated list of AI training from the Accelerate Programme, the wider University and other sources. It covers an intro course (AI Core Concepts), 1-day Accelerate workshops (e.g. Introduction to Generative AI, LLMs, Hands-On Agentic AI, Docker for Science), Accelerate–Cambridge Spark courses, University courses, textbooks and external tutorials.

**Why it matters:** Each item is tagged by level (Newcomer / Intermediate / Proficient), so it's a quick way to point researchers to training that fits their starting point. Workshop materials are open to work through at your own pace.

**Best fit:** Training / upskilling

**Notes:** Workshops are booked through the University training booking system (UTBS). The same hub also lists Accelerate's Clinic and Community pages.
